We provide reliable standalone solutions, a worldwide service and sales network, tailored innovations, and large-scale customized solutions across many industries we focus on:

BARTEC Academy

industries.

pages.title: About BARTEC - Bartec
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Welcome to the BARTEC Group
Safety beyond protection
BARTEC is your global partner and a leading expert in explosion protection and safety technology in hazardous areas. Our explosion protection products and solutions protect people, the environment, and assets – every single day, providing safety beyond protection.
Oil and gas
Chemical
Pharmaceutical
Energy
Manufacturing and Logistics
Hydrogen
Food and Beverages
BARTEC key advantages
What began in 1975 with the invention of a small explosion-proof switch for gasoline pumps has evolved over the past five decades into a success story that sets global standards. BARTEC’s story is based on 50 years of the utmost reliability and experience in explosion protection.
Today, the digital transformation has reached the Ex zone, and we are once again creating more possibilities for our customers. We do this without compromising on safety. BARTEC focuses on innovative, globally certified products; we deliver one of the broadest product portfolios on the market; we ensure proven standalone solutions, a global service and sales network, customized developments, and large-scale customized solutions.
BARTEC is your global partner for hazardous areas
BARTEC is a specialist in explosion protection and safety technology that sets global standards - always committed to the BARTEC purpose: Protecting what is most important.
We provide our solutions and products globally, and we are present in all global regions: CENE, SEMEIA, SNAM and APAC.
BARTEC currently has more than 1000 employees globally, with 11 production sites and more than 50 subsidiaries across the world.
Our BARTEC production sites are in: Bad Mergentheim (Headquarter), Gotteszell, Reinbek (Germany); Cheshire (United Kingdom); Milano, Moraro (Italy); Sandnes (Norway); Zagorje ob Savi (Slovenia); Al Khobar (Saudi Arabia); Pinghu (China) and Chicago (USA).
Our business units
In tune with the requirements of our customers
We seek to support our customers: from problem to solution. This requires a deep understanding of the industries and the specific requirements of explosion protection, which is why BARTEC focuses its experience and expertise in four business units. This functional structuring permits proven precision solutions, as well as customized solutions for special requirements.
Our comprehensive product range extends from complex measurement and analysis technology through innovative heating technology solutions to explosion-protected components and systems for automation, control, and regulation, as well as communication.
In addition, our development teams have decades of experience in finding the right solution to each and every technical challenge.
Electrical safety systems & Enterprise Mobility (ESS)
The ESS business unit delivers integrated electrical safety, connectivity, and enterprise mobility solutions for hazardous areas worldwide
As a trusted partner, we support customers with a broad range of standardized products and engineered solutions for critical electrical infrastructure, including Distribution Panels, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, Low Voltage (LV) assemblies and Ring Main Units (RMUs), alongside explosion-protected equipment, industrial communication technologies, IIoT capabilities and intrinsically safe mobile computing devices.
By combining expertise in power distribution, hazardous area protection, and digital connectivity, we help customers ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Our solutions support the control, monitoring and distribution of power, enable seamless communication across industrial environments and provide field personnel with secure access to critical information and applications.
We work with many of the world’s leading end users, EPCs, and OEMs, supporting complex and safety-critical projects across industries such as Oil & Gas, Energy, Pharma, Chemicals and Logistics. Backed by decades of engineering expertise, global service capabilities, and full compliance with international safety standards, we deliver value throughout the entire project lifecycle—from design and implementation to long-term operation and support.
Electric heating technology (EHT)
Our heat-tracing solutions keep pipes frost-free, support production processes, and help to warm up critical materials.
Electric heat tracing is the most efficient type of heating: the energy can be transported anywhere with almost no loss. If maintenance work becomes necessary, all areas are easily accessible and the heating system can be serviced effortlessly after switching it off. Electric heat tracers are easy to design and simple to install.
Process analyzer technology (PAT)
Our division provides customized engineering solutions with a full suite of physical property analyzers, accessories, and analyzer shelters.

pages.title: Quality Management - Bartec
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Quality and Safety are Our Business
Quality management at BARTEC
BARTEC‘s operational processes are aligned with its corporate aims: achieving the highest levels of quality and reliability, ensuring comprehensive occupational safety, and taking into account environmental and health protection goals.
In addition to systematic quality management, BARTEC also pursues consistent occupational safety, health, energy, and environmental protection management for processes and services. This integrated management system is a natural part of all our business activities.
Not only the ideas and activities of a select few are important. Instead, all BARTEC employees are called upon to actively contribute to BARTEC‘s continuous improvement.
The integrated management handbook produced for this purpose describes all organizational procedures and responsibilities. It also includes references to the appropriate internal guidelines for all quality-relevant, environmentally relevant, and safety-relevant activities and processes.
Through the quality, safety, and environmental management systems described in this handbook, BARTEC’s leadership ensures an appropriate and consistently high level of quality, safety, and environmental protection for our products, processes, systems, and services.
All BARTEC practices, products, and solutions comply with key national and international standards and guidelines.
